profile.headline: Software Developer at AltSource, Inc
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer that enjoys designing and implementing technical solutions.  My experience includes time in the transportation, telecommunication, and financial industries, with particular emphasis on large back-end systems.

In my free time, I enjoy playing with embedded processors and microcontrollers,  image/signal processing, and rocketry.

projects.title: Premier Group Website
projects.description: Planned, designed, and created this commercial website for premier group, a contracting company in the DFW area that specializes in commercial door installation. This project was created in pure HTML/CSS and then migrated to the WordPress CMS with PHP on the back-end.
